companies.funding_notes: Verified dust.tt (Paris). Enterprise AI agents platform founded Feb 2023 by Gabriel Hubert and Stanislas Polu (ex-TOTEMS/Stripe; Polu ex-OpenAI). Raised €5M (~$5.5M per TechCrunch) seed 2023-06-27 led by Sequoia with XYZ, GG1, AI Grant, Connect, Motier, Remote First, Tiny Supercomputer, Seedcamp and angels; $16M additional funding 2024-06-27 led by Sequoia (company blog does not label Series A); $40M Series B announced 2026-05-21 led by Abstract and Sequoia with Snowflake Ventures, Datadog, Wing, Aglaé, XYZ and Seedcamp. Seedcamp says total funding over $60M; amount_raised sums disclosed rounds as ~$61.5M using TechCrunch $5.5M for the euro seed.
